notes: Genealogical chain: each construct בֵּן takes a supplied *the*, no article morpheme standing anywhere in it, and each following name takes the *of* of the construct relation (rules 19, 29).
The verbless clause וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת puts the construction-supplied copula on the predicate שְׁמוֹת and leaves אֵלֶּה only its own *these* (rule 20).

Three waws stand before Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah and the ASV writes three *and*s; נֹעָה has no conjunction of its own and the ASV writes none for it, so nothing is added or unrepresented in the name list (rule 42's count).
